header_Authorization:
key=$(sqlite3 -readonly "${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/opencode/opencode.db" "SELECT json_extract(value, '$.key') FROM credential WHERE integration_id = 'opencode' AND active = 1 LIMIT 1;" 2>/dev/null) || key=
if [ -z "$key" ]; then
  key=$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$HOME/.config/opencode/api-key") || exit $?
fi
printf 'Bearer %s\n' "$key"
